2760-4279-6772.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-6772.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-6772.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

751-4289-4359.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2638-2841-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2638-2841-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5256-7084-7889.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.

3398-5231-6525.description:
Declare the creature that has Infantry Shield attached and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering the creature and Hellkite Charger. 
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking equal to the creature's power.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod seven times by sacrificing seven Warriors, adding seven {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
3398-5231-6525.notes: If Hellkite Charger has power 7 or greater, you can attach Infantry Shield to it. Just ensure to resolve the token creation ability first.

686-914-4112.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.

Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Sharuum the Hegemon and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.

Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sharuum the Hegemon trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Repeat.
If opponents control seven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
